author: OsamaBinBangin
body:
Hello all, Im Haitan and I would like to join an Avicus team. I've lots of experience from other pvp (team-based) servers. I can do most positions including defending. I like capping and teaming to get other people on the monument. 
I can get 11 cps with right click which is nice to blockspam: around a monument, on the enemy's part of the skybridge and to cover rushers. I can aim jitter clicking well and I got a nice bow aim to snipe people on nor of the skybridge.

My combo tactic is block-hitting until the opponent KB's and then right-left strafing.

Other pro's: Im asian

Skype: noahthegster
